identificationModule.briefTitle: Specified Drug Use Survey on AJOVY Subcutaneous Injection for Long-term Use
identificationModule.officialTitle: AJOVY Subcutaneous Injection Long-term Specified Use-results Survey

descriptionModule.briefSummary: To evaluate the long-term safety of AJOVY in patients under actual use conditions and to specifically evaluate cardiovascular events. In addition, information on efficacy will be collected.

armGroups.label: Drug
armGroups.description: Ajovy syringe for SC injection 225 mg.
interventionNames: Drug: Fremanezumab 225 Mg/1.5 mL Subcutaneous Solution

interventions.name: Fremanezumab 225 Mg/1.5 mL Subcutaneous Solution
interventions.description: The usual adult dose is 225 mg of fremanezumab (genetical recombination) administered subcutaneously as a single dose once every 4 weeks or 675 mg administered subcutaneously as a single dose once every 12 weeks.

primaryOutcomes.description:
Any untoward medicinal occurrence in a patient or clinical study subject administered a Medicinal Product and which does not necessarily have a causal relationship with this treatment (see Annex Ⅳ, ICH-E2A Guideline).

An Adverse Event can therefore be any unfavorable and unintended sign (e.g. abnormal laboratory finding), symptom, or disease temporally associated with the use of a Medicinal Product, whether or not it is considered causally related to the Medicinal Product.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 2 years from the start date of treatment
2 years from the start date of treatment

primaryOutcomes.description: Collecting any type of off-Label Use that refers to situations where a product is intentionally used for a medical purpose not in accordance with the authorized product information. Off-label use also includes the intentional use in non-authorized population categories not indicated in the label.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 2 years from the start date of treatment

primaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence of Serious Adverse Event (e.g. resulting in death or life-threatening)
primaryOutcomes.description:
Collecting the number of any adverse drug experience/event occurring at any dose which

* results in death
* is life-threatening
* requires inpatient hospitalization or prolonged of existing hospitalization
* results in persistent or significant disability or incapacity
* is a congenital anomaly/birth defect
* is medically significant.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 2 years from the start date of treatment

primaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence of Non-serious Adverse Events (i.e. all Adverse Events that do not meet the definition of a serious Adverse Event)
primaryOutcomes.description: Collecting the number of non-serious Adverse Events
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 2 years from the start date of treatment
